comment: macpro71: a desktop PC (MSI B460M PRO MS-7C88, Core i5-10400 Comet Lake-S, Radeon RX 580 Polaris, Intel AX210 Wi-Fi, Realtek 8168 Ethernet, Realtek ALC892) started as a MacPro7,1: the SMBIOS the macpro71 pack's OpenCore configuration gives it. Tahoe supports MacPro7,1 natively, so its donors and OCLP's base config fit; the machine has no Apple firmware and no T2.

efi_build.comment: Same ESP base as generic: the qemu_reference_efi row (OpenCore on OVMF: EFI/BOOT/BOOTx64.efi, the path non-Apple firmware starts) with the pinned OpenCore release's binaries; the PC's UEFI starts that path, there is no Apple firmware.

cpu.why: The real CPU of the test machine: Intel Core i5-10400 (Comet Lake-S, 6 cores): the Ivy Bridge baseline plus AVX2, FMA, BMI1/2, MOVBE and the other Haswell-and-newer instructions. AVX2 is why the pack's boot-args carry -crypt_force_avx.

UTBMap.kext.source: the USB port map of the macpro71 PC (9 ports of its xHCI), made with USBToolBox by the PC owner: patches/opencore-macpro71/src/UTBMap.kext

opencore_reasons.kext:AppleALC.kext: audio: Realtek ALC892 on the MSI B460M PRO; needs a layout-id (alcid) for this board, not yet chosen
opencore_reasons.kext:RealtekRTL8111.kext: Realtek 8168 Ethernet of the macpro71 PC
opencore_reasons.kext:itlwm.kext: Intel AX210 Wi-Fi of the macpro71 PC (joined with HeliPort)
opencore_reasons.kext:IntelBTPatcher.kext: Lilu plug-in for IntelBluetoothFirmware on macOS 12+
opencore_reasons.kext:BlueToolFixup.kext: macOS 12+ accepts a third-party Bluetooth firmware loader only with it
opencore_reasons.kext:USBToolBox.kext: applies the UTBMap USB port map of the macpro71 PC
opencore_reasons.kext:UTBMap.kext: the USB port map of the macpro71 PC: 9 ports (USB 2 and 3) of its xHCI, applied by USBToolBox
opencore_reasons.device:PciRoot(0x0)/Pci(0x1f,0x3): the Realtek ALC892 audio codec of the macpro71 PC (MSI B460M PRO, PCI 00:1f.3): AppleALC layout-id 1, the layout the PC's own working EFI uses
